# `scc_findings_mail` — version 1.0

Source: `presets/scc/scc-findings-mail.satz`

## Purpose

Security Command Center findings, delivered to a mailbox — the answer to "who
gets told", for a customer who has no SIEM reading the topic.

NEEDS `presets/scc/scc-notifications.satz`: this fragment attaches to the topic
that pack creates and takes the same project. Used without it, the compile stops
with `unknown param 'scc_notification_project'`.

WHAT THE MAIL SAYS. "Security Command Center published findings", with the count
and a link to the alert — not the finding itself. Cloud Monitoring alerts on a
metric, and the metric here is how many messages reached the topic; the finding's
text lives in the topic, in the console and in the BigQuery export. A customer who
wants the finding in the body of the mail needs code — a subscriber that formats
it — and code is not a resource, so it is not in this library.

THREE RESOURCES.

1. a subscription on the topic, because a topic with no subscription drops every
message it receives: the findings would be published to nothing. It keeps
seven days, so a Friday finding survives the weekend;
2. an e-mail notification channel;
3. an alert policy that fires when messages reach the topic at all.

The mailbox must exist and accept mail from `alerting-noreply@google.com`. A group
whose members have no mailboxes drops every alert and nothing in the estate can
see that happening — a group, never a person, because people leave.

NO CLAIM. No catalog control covers Security Command Center, so this pack
witnesses nothing.

## Use it

```
params {
  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  scc_findings_email = cis_central_email
  scc_findings_subscription_name = "{customer_shortname}-scc-findings-retain"
  scc_findings_retention = "604800s"
  scc_findings_channel_name = "SCC findings"
  scc_findings_alert_window = "300s"
}

use "presets/scc/scc-findings-mail.satz"
```

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `cis_central_email` — declared by `monitoring.organization_cis_log_alerts_central`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `customer_shortname` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `scc_notification_project` — declared by `scc_notifications`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scc_findings_email` | Where should Security Command Center findings be delivered — the mailbox that is told a finding arrived | edit | high | — |

**scc_findings_email** — The mail says findings were published and links to them; the finding itself stays in the topic, the console and the export. The mailbox must exist and accept mail from alerting-noreply@google.com — a group whose members have no mailbox drops every alert silently. A group, never a person. The default is the address the organisation's CIS alerts already go to.
